description: A rigorous engineering mode for concise, detailed replies, deliberate delegation, unslopped prose, simple code and verified work, backed by 24 principles and playbooks for features, bug fixes, refactors, investigations and prototypes. Use only on request: when the user asks for rigor mode by name ("use rigor-mode", "rigor mode on") or asks for rigorous, careful or no-slop engineering work ("work on this rigorously", "careful, no-slop engineering", "no slop on this"). It does not start by itself on ordinary features, bug fixes or refactors; those go to their own skills.
